items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I remember Don Albert telling me about--were you with Louie's band when they went way down in the deep south?

ctx.x: He was a terror is right. He'd get up and take a solo--I'll never forget that--we were at the Nixon Grand and (inaudible) I fell off the bandstand.
I remember Don Albert telling me about--were you with Louie's band when they went way down in the deep south?
